$comment: Canonical spawn-capacity + executor-defaults registry. Owned by Skills/agent-spawn-capacity. Caps are per KEY SET (pool), not per model: two routes on one wallet share one cap. Work roles (recon/review/fix/code/refactor/simple/merge) choose the route and the effort. Edit here to change caps, routes, efforts, priorities, or the error-state policy - never hardcode them in a dispatcher.

defaults.liveFreshnessNote: Occupancy counts only genuinely live agents (status running or initializing). Where the source records a heartbeat (heartbeatAt/lastEventAt/lastActivityAt/lastSeenAt/updatedAt) it must be inside this window, and a recorded local pid must still exist. Idle, closed, errored and archived records never hold a slot (defect 2026-11-03: historic sessions adopted as running).

freeWatch.note: Free-tier keys fail fast (observed 2026-10-16: 4/4 Gemini keys spent in ~2 min on 429s). A worker holding a free-tier key is polled every minute until its key fails or its done file lands; two silent 1-min rounds escalate to Release (provider-error) + re-dispatch on the next pool by priority. Free keys must never block paid work.

workRoleGuidance.recon: Read-only investigation, scoping, planning, evidence gathering. Highest effort: a wrong recon poisons every lane after it.
workRoleGuidance.review: Read-only diff review against acceptance criteria. Highest effort: primarily input tokens, needs the full context.
workRoleGuidance.fix: Repair a known defect, usually with a committed red reproduction.
workRoleGuidance.simple: Small, well-scoped task (single file or two, no design judgment). Runs at medium effort on the primary route: full reasoning is waste heat here.
workRoleGuidance.merge: Land a built branch on its integration trunk FROM the repo's trunk checkout. The only work role that writes at the repo root by design (cl-common-hql): a merge worker's job is the trunk itself, so it is admitted without -AllowTrunkWrite and without an exemption record.

gemini.disabledReason: Operator decision 2026-10-29: inconsistent results; do not use Gemini for lane/subagent work.

keys.name: GEMINI_API2_KEY
keys.note: $7 subscription backstop - burned LAST; a paid exhaustion stands 7 days, not until midnight

gemini.description: Third pool tried (free fallback behind opencode-zen). Each KEY carries its own budget (free tier: 15 requests/minute, 1500 requests/day, RPD reset at midnight Pacific); the cap stays at 1 agent, so one key is in play at a time and the others stay fresh. Key selection walks keys[] in ARRAY ORDER, so order IS burn order: free keys first, the paid backstop last. Exhaustion is tracked PER KEY - the executor leaves circulation only when all four are spent, and a spent key is simply skipped. The Gemini CLI reads only GEMINI_API_KEY, so the gate hands back the key's env-var NAME and the dispatcher bridges that one value into the agent's own GEMINI_API_KEY (never a global override, so agents never share a key and a future cap > 1 stays safe).

dailyQuota.note: A per-day exhaustion is not a health problem: it must NOT be canaried, and it must NOT be cleared before the calendar day rolls over. It is scoped to the KEY that hit it; the executor goes out only once every key in keys[] is spent. The in-flight work is re-dispatched to the next pool by priority.

keySources.bridgeEnv: GEMINI_API_KEY (per-agent: the dispatcher reads the selected key and passes it as this variable for that one agent)
keySources.resolutionNote: Machine-scope GEMINI_API_KEY is the live credential; never print it. Free-tier limits: 15 requests/minute, 1500 requests/day.

routes.label: Gemini 4 Argon (Planning / Architecture)

opencode-go.description: One shared wallet behind OPENCODE_GO1..5. Both routes below bill the same key set, so the cap covers primary AND alternate together. This is the FIRST pool tried (operator order 2026-10-22: opencode-go first, free pools after).

keySources.resolutionNote: opencode-go resolves its key ONLY from OPENCODE_GO_KEY / OPENCODE_API_KEY env vars; the auth.json entry is not consulted by spawned opencode processes. The Paseo daemon freezes env, so a repointed key reaches new workers only after a daemon restart.

routes.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (OpenCode harness)
routes.note: Fleet default worker model (operator order 2026-10-25). Effort follows reasoning depth: recon and review run HIGH (operator 2026-11-01 - judging what exists and what is wrong is where a cheap pass costs most), fix/code/refactor run LOW by default and escalate only for complex logic, edge-case handling, or multi-step invariants; never max. Mechanical volume is not a reason to upgrade. OpenCode harness keeps the same opencode-go wallet with less wrapper complexity than DSH.

routes.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (DeepSeek Harness failover)
routes.note: Failover only. Same model and opencode-go wallet; DSH adds a harness/profile layer, so OpenCode is the preferred subagent route. Same role split: recon/review high, fix/code/refactor low unless a named reason says otherwise. `provider` is ONE plain 'provider/model' string that `paseo run --provider` accepts verbatim: DSH's ACP catalog renders its single model as the JSON tuple ["deepseek-official","deepseek-v4.1-flash"] - never copy that tuple in, Paseo resolves the bare model id to the ACP entry. DSH exposes no session modes, so a delegate must not pass --mode build on this route (verified 2026-11-02: --mode build fails with "Invalid mode 'build' for provider 'deepseek-harness'"); the route declares mode 'default' for that reason.

routes.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (explicit opencode-go alias)
routes.note: Explicit alias for the paid opencode-go lane (same model as primary). Kept for callers that pass the shorter provider id. Same role split: recon/review high, fix/code/refactor low.

opencode-zen.description: Operation CheepSeek free lane (Skills/cheepseek): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on OpenCode Zen at zero cost, 200K input / 128K output BILLING guardrails (native 1M/384K - never use on this lane). Enabled and auto-walk eligible as the first free fallback after opencode-go; CheepSeek work selects it explicitly with -Pool opencode-zen. Operator order 2026-10-22 puts opencode-go first and the free pools after it.

dailyQuota.note: Free-lane 429s are frequent (observed: FreeUsageLimitError, including persistent multi-day blocks). A spent marker is per this pool; the brief is re-dispatched onward by priority. If blocks persist past midnight, the error log - not a Clear -Force - is the record the operator reviews.

keySources.resolutionNote: Zen free models resolve through the default opencode auth, not the OPENCODE_GO<n>_KEY set. No per-key pool: one shared Zen entitlement, hence cap 2. Never print credentials; verify the exact provider id via `paseo provider models opencode --json` before first dispatch.

routes.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free (OpenCode Zen)
routes.note: CheepSeek default lane: zero cost ONLY inside 200K input / 128K output guardrails. Free-tier supervision applies (1-min watch until the key fails or the done file lands). Oversize work belongs on the opencode-go flash route.

codex.description: Disabled for automatic routing. Use only when the user explicitly requests Codex; pass -Pool codex -OptInCodex to Acquire. Quota is ACCOUNT-WIDE: one exhausted key kills every Codex worker at once.

keySources.resolutionNote: Account-wide credential in auth.json; there is no per-key pool. A usage-limit failure is account-wide, not per-worker.

routes.label: GPT-6 Luna (Fix / Code / Refactor)
routes.note: Opt-in only: never selected by -Pool auto while the Codex pool is disabled. Requires an explicit user request and -OptInCodex. Paseo supports this Codex model via --provider codex/gpt-6-luna.

routes.label: Sol 6.1 (Recon)
routes.note: Opt-in only: never selected by -Pool auto while the Codex pool is disabled. Requires an explicit user request and -OptInCodex. Paseo supports this Codex model via --provider codex/gpt-6.1-sol.

devin.description: Operator-disabled 2026-10-02. When enabled with a working key, concurrency is 2 and never more.

keySources.resolutionNote: Devin authenticates from its own CLI store; there is no env-var key seam. Never read or print the file.

routes.label: DeepSeek V4 Flash (OpenRouter)
